verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official MCP Server (documented and open-sourced on GitHub) that lets AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf manage the Auth0 tenant (creating apps, deploying Actions, debugging logs, managing users) via natural language, using secure OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization for auth. missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports validating the natural-language UX, and detail on which operations are not yet supported via MCP.
